findings.text: T-1 says the dashboard service 'returns counts only'. It does not: it also returns `next`, up to 10 upcoming appointments with patient and doctor full names. The code comment C14 quotes is not accurate about the response.

findings.text: T-9's basis for 'no contact details on the list' cites design C14, which is about client.ts and says nothing about list columns. The list's columns can be checked in SUMMARY_SELECT (names only), so T-9 could be known, not assumed.
